q2_gaps: sortal / type-noun classifier "a different KIND of N" (also "sort of", "type of") — the of-phrase taxonomy in *Possessive / genitive NP* and *Complements of nouns and adjectives* covers genitives, partitives "of the", measures, about-phrases and nominalization objects, but never a classifier head like "kind", so there is no licensed way to record the kind layer
notes: The existential-locative shape follows the "There was a ledger on the workbench" pattern exactly — witness + type atoms, containment "in" routed to (LocatedIn ...), tense wrapping the entity-attached position atom rather than minting an event. Consequent on the gap above, the sortal head "kind" is dropped and "different" is predicated of the atmosphere itself.
